item.title: Sandstorm is an open source platform for self-hosting web apps.
item.author: emecas
item.description:
Sandstorm is an open source platform for self-hosting web apps.
https://sandstorm.io/

Self-host web-based productivity apps easily and securely.
Sandstorm is an open source project built by a community of volunteers with the goal of making it really easy to run open source web applications.

Issue #122 in emecas/commitit, open, opened on 2023-06-06.
https://github.com/emecas/commitit/issues/122
